card.extNoSeat: This is filled in by a person who signed up earlier — through their own link. Open the link you received.
card.extNoSeatPick: This is filled in by a person who signed up earlier — through their own link. Open the link you received, or choose at the top of the page whom it is for.
card.extNoBase: This completes an entry that does not exist under this link.
card.paperAfter: This still needs a handwritten signature. Print the entry, sign it and hand it to the organiser — without it the entry is not complete. You will also find the printout later under your link.
card.paperAfterSigner: This still needs a handwritten signature. Print the entry, have it signed ({signer}) and hand it to the organiser — without it the entry is not complete. You will also find the printout later under your link.
card.attached: Added to {name} — you will see it under the same link as before.
card.linkOther: This is the address of the person you filled in the form for. Pass it on to them — under it they will see their entry and whatever the parish writes to them. You see it only now, because we store only its fingerprint.
card.linkOwn: This is your address. Under it you will see what you entered — and what the parish writes to you. Save it or bookmark it: you see it only now, because we store only its fingerprint. Nobody can restore it for you.
card.keepClaim: Keep this receipt — it is the only way to get back to your entry later. Nobody can restore it for you.
card.leadsAdd: . Add a person without their own link (e.g. signed up by phone) on the list with “Add person”.
card.closed: Sign-ups through this form are closed.
card.noController: Nobody is responsible for personal data here, so this form collects nothing. The data controller is named by whoever runs the area (Area settings).
card.forOther: You are filling in for someone else — enter their details below. After sending you will get a link for this person: pass it on so they can check their entry.
card.forSeat: The entry will be added to {name} (same link).
card.forRole: Entry for: {name} — the fields will be filled with your saved details.
card.extFor: Addition for: {name} — it joins the entry under the same link.
card.whomHint: Choosing fills the fields with data you have already saved — entered once and shared by all forms. Change them in your own place and they change everywhere. The place created from this entry will belong to the one you chose.
card.unreadableAll: The questions of this form cannot be read here
card.unreadableSome: Some questions ({count}) cannot be read here
card.unreadableWhy: — they are sealed with an area key this browser cannot read.
card.unreadableLocked: You are signed in, but your keys are not in this tab — sign in again to unlock them.
card.unreadableNoAccess: Your account has no access to this area.
card.unreadableSignIn: If you have access to it, sign in or open your access link.
card.unreadablePublic: Should the form be for everyone? Then whoever runs it makes its area public — they will see a hint when opening the form in Modules.
card.paperReady: Consent to sign by hand. Print it, sign it and hand it to the organiser. The printout will also be available after sending and under your link.
card.paperReadySigner: Consent to sign by hand. Print it, have it signed ({signer}) and hand it to the organiser. The printout will also be available after sending and under your link.
card.paperLater: Consent to sign by hand. You can print it once the form is filled in — then sign it and hand it to the organiser. The printout will also be available after sending and under your link.
card.paperLaterSigner: Consent to sign by hand. You can print it once the form is filled in — then have it signed ({signer}) and hand it to the organiser. The printout will also be available after sending and under your link.

ext.addNoKey: Without the form's key nobody can be added.
ext.addHint: You are entering a person who does not sign up themselves (by phone, on paper, or someone else reported them). The answers are sealed like every entry. Such a person has no link of their own.

ext.noPassword: Without the password in this tab the entries cannot be opened.

ext.dropFailed: Could not remove from the list.

ext.officeHint: Only the coordinator fills this in — the person sees neither the questions nor the answers.

ext.allRound: Everyone has an entry in this period.

links.noArea: You read no area from which you could write to this person.
links.chatReaders: It is read by this person and everyone with access to the chosen area — not by others from the form.

links.noPassword: Without the password the link cannot be opened.
links.seatNoKey: There is no key for this place.
links.revokedNoSend: This person's link is withdrawn — there is nothing to send.

links.withdrawAsk: Withdraw the link? This person will lose access through the link; the entry stays.
links.revoked: This person's link was withdrawn on {date} — there is no access through the link any more. The entry stays.
links.title: Person's link
links.old: This link is older and the office cannot read it. A new one will be made with the first SMS (the old one will stop working).
links.locked: Link blocked — someone answered wrongly several times when first opening it. Issue a new one.
links.notOpened: Not opened yet. When first opened it will ask for: {list}.
links.verified: Opened and confirmed {date} — it asks nothing more.
links.asksNothing: This link asks nothing when opened.
links.withdrawTitle: The link stops working. The entry stays.
links.orphanOne: This number belongs to a question that no longer exists — you can send an SMS, but no number confirmation link can be issued for it.
links.orphanMany: These numbers belong to questions that no longer exist — you can send an SMS, but no number confirmation link can be issued for them.
links.addPhoneFirst: First add a phone question to the form.
links.confirmedSms: — this person clicked the link you sent there.
links.confirmedPortal: — this person confirmed it in their portal. That is no proof the phone works — if you need that, send the link.
links.checkSent: Number confirmation link sent {sent}, no answer. Valid until {until}.
links.checkTitle: First opening of the link — what to ask

links.checkNone: The form has no question that could be asked.
links.checkFromNow: Applies to links sent from now on.

own.nothing: Nothing has been sent from this place yet.
own.reviewHint: Before you go on, look through everything saved in the entry — especially phone numbers and e-mail addresses. The office sends messages and links to them. If something is wrong, fix it right away.
own.consentNo: — no (consent was not given or has been withdrawn)
own.smsOkTitle: You opened the link we sent to this number
own.rotateHint: After correcting a phone number or e-mail address you will get a new link — the current one will stop working. That is in case it reached the wrong number.
own.fixedHint: You cannot correct these answers yourself — if needed, write to the office.
own.sealedHint: We seal the changes in this browser. The service will store them without being able to read them.
own.rotateNow: You are changing a number or e-mail — after saving you will get a new link, and the current one will stop working.

pick.questionsFailed: Could not load this form's questions.

pick.allHint: Also answers to questions you add later.

settings.parentalNoPaper: This form asks to tick parental consent (“{label}”), and there is no printout for signing. Ticking is not a parent's signature — the child ticks it.
settings.parentalRequired: This form asks to tick parental consent (“{label}”) — without the tick nobody can send it. Ticking is not a parent's signature — the child ticks it.
settings.parentalRequiredNoPaper: This form asks to tick parental consent (“{label}”) — without the tick nobody can send it, and there is no printout for signing. Ticking is not a parent's signature — the child ticks it.
settings.parentalBetter: Better: in the “Questions” tab tick the requirement “{need}”. The form will recognise minors (by date of birth or a tick box), and whoever comes with written parental consent will see its text without a tick box and can print it for signing at the end of the form (and after sending). Then delete this field — the answers so far stay in the entries.
settings.parentSigner: legible signature of the parent / legal guardian
settings.signer: Who signs (under the line on the printout)
settings.keptPart: , taken off the form (they have answers — these stay in the entries) {count}
settings.needsHint: Tick what the event requires — the form gets the questions it needs. While a requirement is ticked, its questions cannot be deleted.
settings.newSettingsHint: The form will get the questions of the new settings. Questions the new settings do not need will disappear; those someone has already answered are only taken off — their answers stay in the entries.
settings.offHint: The questions added by this requirement will disappear from the form ({count}); those someone has already answered are only taken off — their answers stay in the entries.
settings.offPaper: The printout for signing will be turned off too.
settings.extHint: Sub-forms: the person completes them later through their link, or only the coordinator fills them in.
settings.extRepeatHint: A sub-form can repeat (every day, week, month, year) — then each person has a separate entry for each period.
settings.extNamePlaceholder: e.g. Confirmation details or Coordinator notes
settings.isExt: This is an extension of a form
settings.repeatLocked: There are entries already — the repetition cannot be changed.
settings.repeatEach: A separate entry for each period — in the “Entries” tab you switch the period at the top.
settings.extOfficeHint: Only the office sees the answers. In the “People” tab you enter them for each person; you can also put this form on your coordinator page — it shows the same list there.
settings.extPersonHint: The person will see this in their steps as “Fill in” and fill it in through their link. The clause and the link are the same as in the main form.
